en.headline: Customs dismantles two illicit cigarette warehouses, seizes HK$1.8 million worth
en.dek: Officers arrested a 56-year-old woman and a 60-year-old man on Monday after raiding storage sites in Yuen Long and Tsuen Wan, seizing about 410,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes.
body: Hong Kong Customs dismantled two illicit cigarette storage warehouses in Yuen Long and Tsuen Wan on Monday, seizing about 410,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes with a market value of about HK$1.8 million and a duty value of about HK$1.4 million.

In the first operation around noon, officers intercepted a 56-year-old local woman in Yeung Uk Tsuen, Au Tau, Yuen Long, and found about 19,000 cigarettes in a cardboard box she was carrying. A subsequent search of a nearby warehouse and a private car yielded about 261,000 more.

In the evening, officers intercepted a 60-year-old local man in a residential building in Tsuen Wan and found about 13,000 cigarettes in a nylon bag. A search of a subdivided flat in the building uncovered about 120,000 more. A private car was also detained.

Customs said both suspects were responsible for managing the warehouses and that the locations were chosen to reduce enforcement risk. Handling, possessing, selling or purchasing illicit cigarettes is an offence under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, carrying a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment on conviction.

zh.headline: 海關搗破元朗及荃灣兩個私煙倉檢值180萬
zh.dek: 周一行動中拘捕56歲女子及60歲男子，檢獲約41萬支未完稅香煙，市值約180萬元。
body: 香港海關周一在元朗及荃灣搗破兩個私煙儲存倉庫，檢獲約41萬支未完稅香煙，市值約180萬元，應課稅值約140萬元。
中午時分，人員在元朗凹頭楊屋村截查一名56歲本地女子，在其攜帶的紙箱內搜獲約1.9萬支香煙。其後搜查附近儲存倉及私家車，再檢獲約26.1萬支。
傍晚，人員在荃灣一幢住宅大廈截查一名60歲本地男子，在其尼龍袋內搜獲約1.3萬支。搜查大廈內一個剽房單位後，再檢獲約12萬支。行動中亦扣查一輛私家車。
海關指兩名涉案人士負責管理倉庫，並刻意選擇偏遠或較舊樓宇以降低執法風險。根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙屬違法，一經定罪最高可判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
